title: Switching Door Series on Entry & Patio Door Contracts
content:
An Entry & Patio Door Contract may move to another door series only before order release, and only between series of the same door type (entry to entry, patio to patio), because the rough opening is built for one door type. A door series change can be made only while the contract status is signed or measured.

## Re-pricing

The re-priced contract price is the current contract price plus the difference between the new and the old series base price per unit times the current unit count, before any discount program; where the contract carries a discount program, the program rate of the new series is applied to the re-priced list price instead. Option lines already written stay at the price they were written at; a series change cannot be made while the contract carries an option line the new series does not offer.

## Redesign fee and deposit

A series change made while the contract is measured carries the series redesign fee of the new series; one made while it is signed carries none. If the new series raises the required deposit, the difference is due before order release.

## Conditions at a glance

| Condition | Series change can be made |
|---|---|
| Status signed or measured, same door type, no option line the new series does not offer | Yes |
| Status ordered, installed, closed or cancelled | No |
| Entry series to patio series, or patio to entry | No |
| An option line the new series does not offer is on the contract | No |

| Status when the change is made | Redesign fee |
|---|---|
| Signed | None |
| Measured | The new series' redesign fee |

## Worked case (hypothetical, no discount program)

A Ridgeline Portal 310 Steel Entry Door contract of 2 units, current contract price $4280.00, status measured, moves to the Ridgeline Portal 640 Woodgrain Fiberglass Entry Door. The base price difference is $3460.00 less $2140.00, that is $1320.00 per unit; times 2 units it is $2640.00. The re-priced contract price is $4280.00 plus $2640.00, that is $6920.00. Because the contract is measured, the Portal 640 redesign fee of $150.00 applies. Had the change been made in status signed, no redesign fee would apply.

A Ridgeline Hinge 960 Wood-Clad French Patio Door contract carrying a transom line cannot move to the Ridgeline Glide 840 Fiberglass Sliding Patio Door, which offers no transom.
